info.name: Bearstore API (discovered)
info.description:
Generated from QA discovery (`qa/01-discovery/endpoints.json`). Regenerate with `npm run export:postman`.
Session is cookie based: run the AUTH folder first (Postman keeps cookies between requests), and fill `email` / `password` in the environment.

---
# Auth model - cart area

Sources: the three unit notes.md and endpoints.json files. No claims beyond them.

## Summary
No login is involved. All ten cart endpoints worked anonymously (authRequired false everywhere). The cart (and wishlist) belongs to a guest visitor identified by cookie.

## Session creation
- First request without cookies (any page, e.g. GET / or GET /cart or the product page) creates a guest visitor and sets `SMARTSTORE.VISITOR`.
- `ASP.NET_SessionId` appears on the first `/shoppingcart/offcanvasshoppingcart` call or the first `GET /cart`.
- Add-to-cart (`POST /cart/addproduct/...`) and `POST /shoppingcart/updatecartitem` re-issue `SMARTSTORE.VISITOR` on each response; delete/move responses set no cookie.

## Session destruction
No logout or session end was exercised or observed. The visitor cookie lives one year. Emptying the cart does not end the visitor.

## Cookies and flags
| Cookie | Flags observed | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SMARTSTORE.VISITOR` | HttpOnly, secure, 1 year | Binds cart and wishlist to the visitor. Re-set on add and update responses. |
| `ASP.NET_SessionId` | flags not recorded by the units | Set on the first offcanvas or /cart call. |

## CSRF / anti-forgery
No anti-forgery token was seen or needed: every curl replay (add, update, delete, move) succeeded with only the visitor cookie. cart-add observed that omitting `X-Requested-With` still works for add. Whether the other mutating endpoints require it was not tested (cart-update and cart-remove replays sent it for some calls). No Origin/Referer checks were tested.

## Object-level access (ownership)
- A cart or wishlist line can only be changed or removed by its owner (the visitor whose cookie created it).
- updatecartitem with another visitor's or an unknown id: HTTP 500, nothing changed.
- deletecartitem and moveitembetweencartandwishlist with another visitor's or an unknown id: HTTP 200 `success:false`, line stays.

## Visitor identity in practice (testability)
- The three parallel headed browsers appeared to share one guest cart (same IP and User-Agent probably key the guest visitor). Each unit saw lines it had not created, and counters moved on their own.
- curl jars with a unique User-Agent each behaved deterministically and were fully isolated.
- Tests should use a fresh request context with its own unique User-Agent. Cause of the sharing is unconfirmed (see open questions).

## Protected paths
None of the explored paths require authentication. `GET /checkout` with an empty cart answered `302 Location: /cart` (read-only check by cart-remove; it is an empty-cart redirect, not a login redirect). Checkout, account and login were not explored in this scope.

## Transport requirements related to auth-less POSTs
POST endpoints without a body need `Content-Length: 0` (curl `-d ""`), otherwise IIS answers 411.

item.name: GET /cart - Render the shopping cart page (server-rendered HTML), including the empty-cart state and per-line remove/move links.

request.description:
Render the shopping cart page (server-rendered HTML), including the empty-cart state and per-line remove/move links.

**Endpoint id:** `EP-CART-VIEW`
**Auth required:** no
**Verified by replay:** yes

**Success:** 200 ("Non-empty: lines with data-href="/shoppingcart/deletecartitem?cartItemId=<id>" and ".../moveitembetweencartandwishlist?cartItemId=<id>&cartType=ShoppingCart&isCartPage=True" plus inputs itemquantity<id>. Empty: text "Your Shopping Cart is empty!" (data-empty-text attribute is always present, so do not match on it alone).")

exec: pm.test("EP-CART-VIEW: status is 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("sets cookie ASP.NET_SessionId", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase() === "set-cookie").map(h => h.value).join("\n")).to.include("ASP.NET_SessionId="));

pm.test("sets cookie SMARTSTORE.VISITOR (on first request)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase() === "set-cookie").map(h => h.value).join("\n")).to.include("SMARTSTORE.VISITOR (on first request)="));

pm.test("body contains expected signal", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("Non-empty: lines with data-href=\"/shoppingcart/deletecartitem?cartItemId=<id>\" and \".../moveitembetweencartandwishlist?cartItemId=<id>&cartType=ShoppingCart&isCartPage=True\" plus inputs itemquantity<id>. Empty: text \"Your Shopping Cart is empty!\" (data-empty-text attribute is always present, so do not match on it alone)."));

item.name: POST /cart/addproduct/{productId}/{cartType} - Add a product to the cart (cartType 1) via XHR form post; repeat adds of the same product accumulate quantity on one cart line.

request.description:
Add a product to the cart (cartType 1) via XHR form post; repeat adds of the same product accumulate quantity on one cart line.

**Endpoint id:** `EP-CART-ADD-PRODUCT`
**Auth required:** no
**Changes server state:** yes
**Verified by replay:** yes

**Success:** 200 ("JSON {"success":true} (plus a $type property)")
**Failure:** 200 ("Invalid quantity: {"success":false,"message":["Quantity should be positive"]}. Unknown productId 999999: {"redirect":"/"}. productId 0 or abc: HTTP 404 HTML. GET method: 404. Bodyless POST must still send Content-Length (curl -d '') or IIS returns 411.")

exec: pm.test("EP-CART-ADD-PRODUCT: status is 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("sets cookie SMARTSTORE.VISITOR (re-set each response)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase() === "set-cookie").map(h => h.value).join("\n")).to.include("SMARTSTORE.VISITOR (re-set each response)="));
pm.test("body contains expected signal", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("JSON {\"success\":true} (plus a $type property)"));

item.name: POST /shoppingcart/cartsummary - Return the header counters (cart, wishlist, compare item counts) as JSON; the UI calls it after each add and on every page load.

query.description: Include CartItemsCount (the UI sends cart=True after an add).
Include wishlist counter (page load sends cart=True&wishlist=True&compare=True).

request.description:
Return the header counters (cart, wishlist, compare item counts) as JSON; the UI calls it after each add and on every page load.

**Endpoint id:** `EP-CART-SUMMARY`
**Auth required:** no
**Verified by replay:** yes

**Success:** 200 ("JSON {"CartItemsCount":n,"WishlistItemsCount":n,"CompareItemsCount":n}. CartItemsCount is the sum of quantities, not the number of lines.")
**Failure:** 404 ("GET returns 404 HTML; POST without Content-Length returns 411.")

exec: pm.test("EP-CART-SUMMARY: status is 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("body contains expected signal", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("JSON {\"CartItemsCount\":n,\"WishlistItemsCount\":n,\"CompareItemsCount\":n}. CartItemsCount is the sum of quantities, not the number of lines."));

item.name: POST /shoppingcart/deletecartitem - Remove one line from the cart by its cart item id.

query.description: Cart line id (not product id), taken from the /cart HTML. Ids are global counters, not 1..n.

request.description:
Remove one line from the cart by its cart item id.

**Endpoint id:** `EP-CART-DELETE-ITEM`
**Auth required:** no
**Changes server state:** yes
**Verified by replay:** yes

**Success:** 200 ("JSON {success:true, message:"The product has been removed.", cartItemCount:<n>, cartHtml, totalsHtml, displayCheckoutButtons}. After the last line cartItemCount is 0.")
**Failure:** 200 ("Unknown id, already-removed id, or id owned by another visitor: JSON {success:false, displayCheckoutButtons, message:"An error occurred during the removal of the product."}. GET gives 404 HTML. Missing or non-numeric cartItemId gives 502 Bad Gateway (HTML).")

exec: pm.test("EP-CART-DELETE-ITEM: status is 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("body contains expected signal", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("JSON {success:true, message:\"The product has been removed.\", cartItemCount:<n>, cartHtml, totalsHtml, displayCheckoutButtons}. After the last line cartItemCount is 0."));

item.name: POST /shoppingcart/moveitembetweencartandwishlist - Move a cart line to the wishlist (the line leaves the cart and gets a NEW id on the wishlist).

query.description: Id of the line in the cart.
Source list of the line: ShoppingCart (move to wishlist).
UI flag; the UI always sends True. Effect of omitting it not tested.

request.description:
Move a cart line to the wishlist (the line leaves the cart and gets a NEW id on the wishlist).

**Endpoint id:** `EP-CART-MOVE-TO-WISHLIST`
**Auth required:** no
**Changes server state:** yes
**Verified by replay:** yes

**Success:** 200 ("JSON {success:true, wasMoved:true, message:"The product has been added to your wishlist", cartHtml, totalsHtml, cartItemCount, displayCheckoutButtons}. Line now appears on /wishlist with a new cartItemId.")
**Failure:** 200 ("Unknown id: JSON {success:false, message:"Product could not be added to the shopping cart."} (wording is misleading). POST with no Content-Length: 411 HTML. GET: 404 HTML. Missing cartItemId: 502 HTML.")

exec: pm.test("EP-CART-MOVE-TO-WISHLIST: status is 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("body contains expected signal", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("JSON {success:true, wasMoved:true, message:\"The product has been added to your wishlist\", cartHtml, totalsHtml, cartItemCount, displayCheckoutButtons}. Line now appears on /wishlist with a new cartItemId."));

item.name: POST /shoppingcart/moveitembetweencartandwishlist - Move a wishlist line back into the cart (the line gets a NEW id in the cart).

query.description: Id of the line on the wishlist, from the /wishlist HTML.
Source list of the line: Wishlist (move to cart).
UI flag; the UI sends True.

request.description:
Move a wishlist line back into the cart (the line gets a NEW id in the cart).

**Endpoint id:** `EP-CART-MOVE-TO-CART`
**Auth required:** no
**Changes server state:** yes
**Verified by replay:** yes

**Success:** 200 ("JSON {success:true, wasMoved:true, message:"The product has been added to your shopping cart", cartHtml, totalsHtml, cartItemCount, displayCheckoutButtons}.")
**Failure:** 200 ("Unknown id: JSON {success:false, message:"Product could not be added to the shopping cart."}.")

exec: pm.test("EP-CART-MOVE-TO-CART: status is 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("body contains expected signal", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("JSON {success:true, wasMoved:true, message:\"The product has been added to your shopping cart\", cartHtml, totalsHtml, cartItemCount, displayCheckoutButtons}."));

item.name: POST /shoppingcart/offcanvasshoppingcart - Return the mini-cart (offcanvas) HTML fragment with the current cart lines, quantities and subtotal.

request.description:
Return the mini-cart (offcanvas) HTML fragment with the current cart lines, quantities and subtotal.

**Endpoint id:** `EP-CART-OFFCANVAS`
**Auth required:** no
**Verified by replay:** yes

**Success:** 200 ("text/html fragment div.offcanvas-cart-body with item rows (input name item.EnteredQuantity, data-sci-id = cart line id, data-update-url /shoppingcart/updatecartitem), subtotal, links to /cart and checkout. In the browser, right after an add it also contained an alert 'The product <name> has been successfully added to your cart'; the curl replay did not show that alert.")
**Failure:** 411 ("POST without Content-Length: IIS 'HTTP Error 411'. GET also returns 200 with the same fragment.")

exec: pm.test("EP-CART-OFFCANVAS: status is 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("sets cookie ASP.NET_SessionId (first call)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase() === "set-cookie").map(h => h.value).join("\n")).to.include("ASP.NET_SessionId (first call)="));
pm.test("sets cookie SMARTSTORE.VISITOR", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase() === "set-cookie").map(h => h.value).join("\n")).to.include("SMARTSTORE.VISITOR="));

pm.test("body contains expected signal", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("text/html fragment div.offcanvas-cart-body with item rows (input name item.EnteredQuantity, data-sci-id = cart line id, data-update-url /shoppingcart/updatecartitem), subtotal, links to /cart and checkout. In the browser, right after an add it also contained an alert 'The product <name> has been successfully added to your cart'; the curl replay did not show that alert."));

item.name: POST /shoppingcart/updatecartitem - Set the quantity of one cart line (identified by sciItemId) and return the recalculated line and order totals as JSON including rendered cart HTML.

query.description: ShoppingCartItem id of the line, taken from the id/name itemquantity<id> on GET /cart or the data-href of the quantity input.
Sent by the UI on /cart; selects the cart-page rendering of the response.
Also accepted in the query string (model binding); the UI sends it in the body.

request.description:
Set the quantity of one cart line (identified by sciItemId) and return the recalculated line and order totals as JSON including rendered cart HTML.

**Endpoint id:** `EP-CART-UPDATE-ITEM`
**Auth required:** no
**Changes server state:** yes
**Verified by replay:** yes

**Success:** 200 ("JSON {success:true, SubTotal:'$9.50 excl tax', message:[], cartHtml:'<html of the cart rows>', displayCheckoutButtons:true, newItemPrice:'$1.90 excl tax'}; cartHtml contains the new line total and the order total; GET /cart then shows the new itemquantity<id> value.")
**Failure:** 200 ("Over limit: 200 with JSON {success:false, message:['The maximum quantity allowed for purchase is 10000.'] or ['Your quantity exceeds stock on hand. The maximum quantity that can be added is 8563.'], SubTotal unchanged}; quantity unchanged. Quantity 0 / negative: line is removed but response is 500 {error:true, controller:'shoppingcart', action:'updatecartitem', message:'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'}. Unknown sciItemId or an item owned by another visitor: 500 same body, nothing changed. Non-numeric/empty/2.5/missing newQuantity: 502 HTML 'Bad Gateway' (awselb/2.0). GET: 404.")

exec: pm.test("EP-CART-UPDATE-ITEM: status is 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("sets cookie SMARTSTORE.VISITOR (re-issued, HttpOnly, secure, 1 year)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase() === "set-cookie").map(h => h.value).join("\n")).to.include("SMARTSTORE.VISITOR (re-issued, HttpOnly, secure, 1 year)="));

pm.test("body contains expected signal", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("JSON {success:true, SubTotal:'$9.50 excl tax', message:[], cartHtml:'<html of the cart rows>', displayCheckoutButtons:true, newItemPrice:'$1.90 excl tax'}; cartHtml contains the new line total and the order total; GET /cart then shows the new itemquantity<id> value."));
